summary: Duplicate generic products are present for paracetamol (Napa and Ace) and amlodipine (Camlodin and Amdocal), each prescribed by different providers. [R1] [R2] [F18] [F11]

Tryptin (amitriptyline) is expired, has a major interaction with Rivotril (clonazepam) that increases drowsiness and fall risk, and contributes an anticholinergic burden score of 3 associated with confusion and falls in older adults. [R3] [R4] [R5] [F4] [F8] [F10] [F12]

Clofenac (diclofenac) is near expiry, listed in the AGS Beers Criteria for adults 65+, and has moderate interactions with Angilock (losartan) and Comet (metformin) that may reduce blood pressure control and increase kidney strain, while Comet (metformin) requires benefit-risk assessment due to eGFR below 45.
